episodeTitle.zh: 工程师迫切希望产品经理理解的事 | 卡米尔·福尼尔（《管理者之路》）

guestBioOfficial.en: Camille Fournier is the author of The Manager’s Path, which many consider the definitive guide for navigating one’s career path in tech. Camille was previously the CTO of Rent the Runway, VP of Technology at Goldman Sachs, Head of Platform Engineering at Two Sigma, and Global Head of Engineering and Architecture at JPMorgan Chase. She is about to release new newest book, Platform Engineering: A Guide for Technical, Product, and People Leaders. In our conversation, we discuss: • What product managers do that annoys engineers
guestBioOfficial.zh: 卡米尔·福尼尔是《管理者之路》的作者，该书被许多人视为科技行业职业发展路径的权威指南。卡米尔曾担任Rent the Runway的首席技术官、高盛公司的技术副总裁、Two Sigma公司的平台工程主管，以及摩根大通的全球工程与架构负责人。她即将出版新书《平台工程：技术、产品与人员领导者的指南》。在对话中，我们讨论了：• 产品经理做哪些事会让工程师感到厌烦

title.en: The things engineers are desperate for PMs to understand | Camille Fournier (“The Manager’s Path”)
title.zh: 工程师迫切希望产品经理理解的事 | 卡米尔·福尼尔（《管理者之路》）

summary.en: Camille tackles what PMs do that annoys engineers—hoarding credit and not understanding technical details—and why the best PMs talk least and encourage others to present. She stresses that engineers want to understand the business and customer problem, not just write code, and that great PMs aren't threatened by others' ideas. The conversation is a frank guide to PM-engineer dynamics and becoming a trusted partner to engineering.
summary.zh: Camille 剖析了产品经理哪些行为惹恼工程师——独吞功劳、不懂技术细节——以及为何最好的 PM 话最少、鼓励别人来展示。她强调工程师想理解业务与客户问题，而非只写代码，而优秀的 PM 不会被他人的想法威胁。对话是关于 PM 与工程师关系的坦率指南，教你成为工程师信赖的伙伴。
